billing_method.description: How the project bills: only a time-and-materials project bills its time; a fixed fee bills by milestone, a retainer draws time down, and an internal project bills nothing.

expenses.description: Posted billable costs in the project's currency, at cost plus markup.

expenses_in_other_currencies.description: Billable costs in another currency: they are not on the project's invoice.

has_customer.description: false when the project has no customer, so no invoice can be drafted.

time.description: Priced approved billable time not yet on a posted invoice, by day.

total.description: What an invoice of it all comes to before GST.

unpriced_time.description: Approved billable time that no billing rate covers: enter a rate from the day (setBillingRate) to bill it.
